title: Chapter 172: Seeking Saint Zhang Liang
content:
Chapter 172: Seeking Saint Zhang Liang

Above the court, everyone looked at Ji Wuye, surprised, shocked, unbelievable, and didn't understand why he would push away such a good opportunity?

This is an opportunity to get in touch with King Jing of the Yu Kingdom at close range. You must know that according to the information obtained by everyone, the emperor of the Yu Kingdom has no heirs, only such a biological brother.

what does that mean? It means that King Jing is very likely to be the next heir to Yuguo, and he may inherit this big country with a territory of tens of thousands of miles and millions of soldiers.

Such a rare opportunity to get close to the heirs of a big country, even if they are subjects of South Korea, is extremely eye-catching. If they can build a good relationship with King Jing, they can go to Yuguo if they can't get along in Korea in the future.

Even further, it can completely replace the intermediary between South Korea and Yuguo, and act as an important relationship between Yuguo and South Korea. It is not impossible to become the second Su Qin who wears the seal of the six countries!

Ministers of every country have always been vying for this kind of opportunity. Why did this great general, Ji Wuye, change from his previous greedy and insatiable character? How about humility? The ministers couldn't help but ponder in their hearts.

However, Ji Wuye would not think about their thoughts, because he could guess without thinking, they are laughing at themselves in their hearts right now!

However, these stupid people never thought that the person they were going to receive next would have such a bad personality.

"He dared to send troops to attack Yan State, one of the seven heroes of the Warring States Period, because of a woman. He also killed tens of thousands of surrendering soldiers from Yan State who deliberately released water because he should go out of the city to break through the siege. Gather the heads of those soldiers who broke out from the siege, and form a peerless murderer who will threaten the capital of the Yan Kingdom for peace!" Ji Wuye sighed in his heart, and he didn't want to let go of this opportunity, but he didn't know what to do. , able to please that Prince Jing.

However, since his power in South Korea is second only to the King of Han, he has no end. Those who are not as good as him must be even more miserable. Not everyone can accept this job.

Although he may not show the consequences of offending that Prince Jing on the spot, but in his heart, it is enough for that person to drink a pot.

Looking at the prime minister's open face, Ji Wuye's eyes showed a trace of coldness, and his heart was filled with a sneer.

"Your Majesty, I feel that the Prime Minister is indeed a good candidate, and no one in the court can compare with him!" Ji Wuye once again expressed his opinion to King Han, and at the same time expressed his opinion to those under his command. manner.

Sure enough, seeing his boss talking like this, how dare those followers who follow suit go against his boss' wishes? They also remonstrated with King Han one after another.

"Your Majesty, the ministers also think that the prime minister is the perfect candidate!"

"This..., Prime Minister, what do you think? Are you willing to take on this errand?" Han Wang saw that since Ji Wuye didn't want to take on this errand, he pushed it on his deadly enemy Zhang Kaidi instead, which was not good. Reluctantly, he turned his head to look at him, and thought it would be more appropriate to open the ground.

"Your Majesty, since all the princes in the court are unwilling to take up this errand, instead recommending the humble minister, the humble minister can only do his best to make this trip!" Although Zhang Kaidi felt a little uneasy, Ji Wuye His attitude was obviously abnormal, but he thought about it again and again. Due to the lack of information, he still couldn't think that this errand would do him any harm, but it would be of great benefit, so he stopped hesitating.

"Okay, since the prime minister dares to take on this role, the lonely king will appoint you as the envoy reception official this time, with full authority to preside over the reception matters. All departments in South Korea will cooperate with each other. If you obstruct, the prime minister can kill first and then play!" Seeing Zhang Kaidi agreed, King Han was overjoyed, and immediately granted him extremely powerful powers.

After Ji Wuye's analysis just now, King Han attaches great importance to himself as a potential ally, and regards him as a life-saving talisman for the survival of South Korea. How could he allow those under him to do something about this matter? Broken South Korea's long-term plan.

Therefore, Zhang Kaidi was granted the right to kill first and play later, and what he said was also murderous. He kept scanning the ministers above the court and warned them not to tamper with this matter. It is not within their reach. .

"The ministers will definitely cooperate with all their strength, and dare not violate it!" Many ministers in the court were swept away by King Han's gaze, and their hearts suddenly trembled, and they put away their original thoughts, and bowed to respond.

"Since all the ministers are meaningless, let's stop today's discussion of politics and retreat!" King Han got up, sitting on the throne for so long, he was a little sore because of his fat body, rubbed his body, and under the eunuch's service down, left.

"Farewell to Your Majesty!" The officials behind me remembered their neat voices.

After a while, seeing that King Han had left, these ministers got up together, gathered together in twos and threes, and left the palace.

Xinzheng City is located in the center of the city, close to the Prime Minister's Mansion of the Royal Palace. This is the mansion opened by the Prime Minister of South Korea. It covers an area of ten acres. The decoration is magnificent, but it does not appear to be ostentatious. Qi, fully shows the heritage of the five generations of the Zhang family.

Inside the mansion, by the garden pond.

With his arms open, he held a handful of fish food in his left hand and threw it into the pond from time to time, watching the many golden carps scrambling for it, but he didn't pay attention to these things in his mind, instead he was thinking about other things.

"Grandfather, I heard that the king appointed you as the chief officer to receive the imperial envoys, and this appointment was made by the general Ji Wuye on his own initiative?" Behind him, there was a slight sound of footsteps, and at the same time, there was a There was a gentle voice.

"Zifang, what do you think of this matter?" Zhang Kaidi didn't turn his head, but asked such a question to the owner who heard the voice.

"My lord, grandfather, I think that Ji Wuye's abnormal behavior must have some meaning. My lord grandfather may be in the way when he takes on this job." It turns out that this person is Zhang Kaidi's proud grandson. The well-known murderer Zhang Liang.

"I know it's harmful, but I just don't understand where it's hindering!" He frowned openly, a little dissatisfied with his grandson's answer.

"Zifang heard that King Jing of the Royal Kingdom once clashed with Lord Yanchun of the Kingdom of Yan in the Feixue Pavilion of the Kingdom of Yan, and he also likes to build the enemy's head into a palace to deter the enemy, and On the battlefield that attacked Yan back then, tens of thousands of our own soldiers who were disadvantaged in the battle were beheaded with one order!" Zhang Liang didn't call names, but said these specious words.

"So that's it, I understand!" Zhang Kai nodded, and then concentrated on watching the fish grabbing food.

There was silence again by the pond.
